title: New results on Fourier multipliers on $L^p$: a perspective through unimodular symbols
summary: The paper focuses on the behaviour of unimodular Fourier multipliers with exponential growth in the context of weighted $L^p$-spaces. Our main result shows that much of the general theory of multipliers is approachable through the theory of unimodular multipliers. Indeed, we show that a bounded measurable function $m$ is a multiplier on $L^p$ for $1\leq p 0$ and $0<s<1$. We then apply this principle to obtain new results related to the boundedness of homogeneous rough operators, singular operators along curves and oscillatory integrals.
